product_overview: Rawy is a backend REST API (MVP) for a podcast platform supporting Users, Creators and Admin roles, offering authentication (email/password + OAuth), podcast and episode management, user interactions (likes, follows, comments, views) and admin controls.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication (JWT access + refresh) including Google and Facebook OAuth
Enable Creators to create/manage podcasts and episodes with file uploads
Support user interactions: likes, comments, follows and view counting while preventing duplicates
Deliver push notification registration and trigger notifications to followers on new episodes
Expose admin controls for user and content moderation and platform statistics
Document all endpoints with Swagger and enforce input validation with class-validator

features.name: App Health
features.description: Health check endpoint for service liveness and basic readiness.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/ -> Receive 200 with string (health status)
GET /api/v1/ (when DB or dependent service is down) -> Receive 503 Service Unavailable

features.name: Auth API
features.description: User registration, login, token refresh, logout, and OAuth flows (Google/Facebook).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid email/password -> Receive 201 with TokenResponse (access + refresh)
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse (access + refresh)
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with valid refresh token -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse (new access + refresh)
POST /api/v1/auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 void
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/v1/auth/google -> Receive 302 redirect to Google OAuth consent
GET /api/v1/auth/google/callback with provider code -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse (access + refresh)
GET /api/v1/auth/facebook -> Receive 302 redirect to Facebook OAuth consent
GET /api/v1/auth/facebook/callback with provider code -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse (access + refresh)

features.name: Users API
features.description: Fetch and update current user profile and manage device tokens for push notifications.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
GET /api/v1/users/me with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with User
PATCH /api/v1/users/me with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and valid update body -> Receive 200 with updated User
POST /api/v1/users/me/device-token with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and device token body -> Receive 200 void
DELETE /api/v1/users/me/device-token with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and device token body -> Receive 200 void
GET /api/v1/users/me without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
PATCH /api/v1/users/me with invalid data (failing validation) -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Podcasts API
features.description: Create, list, retrieve, update and delete podcasts. Public listing and details are available without authentication; modifications require Creator/owner authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with creator credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/podcasts with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and valid podcast body (title, description, cover image) -> Receive 201 with Podcast
GET /api/v1/podcasts -> Receive 200 with Podcast[]
GET /api/v1/podcasts/:id without Authorization -> Receive 200 with Podcast
GET /api/v1/podcasts/:id with non-existent id -> Receive 404 Not found
PATCH /api/v1/podcasts/:id with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> as owner and valid update -> Receive 200 with Podcast
PATCH /api/v1/podcasts/:id with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> but not owner -> Receive 403 Forbidden
DELETE /api/v1/podcasts/:id with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> as owner -> Receive 200 void
POST /api/v1/podcasts without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Episodes API
features.description: Create, list, retrieve, update and delete episodes. Episode creation uploads audio and triggers follower notifications; public reads allowed, modifications restricted to episode owner.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with creator credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/episodes with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and valid episode body (title, description, audio file) -> Receive 201 with Episode (server triggers push notifications to followers)
GET /api/v1/episodes -> Receive 200 with Episode[]
GET /api/v1/episodes/:id -> Receive 200 with Episode
GET /api/v1/episodes/:id with non-existent id -> Receive 404 Not found
PATCH /api/v1/episodes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> as owner -> Receive 200 with Episode
DELETE /api/v1/episodes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> as owner -> Receive 200 void
POST /api/v1/episodes with missing required fields or missing audio -> Receive 400 Validation error
POST /api/v1/episodes without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Creators API
features.description: Allow users to become creators, view creator lists and profiles, and update their creator profile.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with user credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/creators/become with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and valid creator data -> Receive 201 with Creator
POST /api/v1/creators/become with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and invalid data -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /api/v1/creators -> Receive 200 with Creator[]
GET /api/v1/creators/me with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with Creator
GET /api/v1/creators/:id -> Receive 200 with Creator
GET /api/v1/creators/:id with non-existent id -> Receive 404 Not found
PATCH /api/v1/creators/me with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and valid update body -> Receive 200 with Creator

features.name: Follows API
features.description: Follow or unfollow creators, check follow status and list following/followers.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with user credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 201 with Follow
DELETE /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 void
GET /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId/status with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with {"following": boolean}
GET /api/v1/follows/me/following with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with Creator[]
GET /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId/followers -> Receive 200 with User[]
POST /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> for non-existent creator -> Receive 404 Not found
POST /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Likes API
features.description: Like or unlike episodes and get like status for the current user.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with user credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/likes/episodes/:episodeId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 201 with Like
DELETE /api/v1/likes/episodes/:episodeId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 void
GET /api/v1/likes/episodes/:episodeId/status with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with {"liked": boolean}
POST /api/v1/likes/episodes/:episodeId for non-existent episode with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 404 Not found
POST /api/v1/likes/episodes/:episodeId without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Comments API
features.description: Add, list and delete comments on episodes (flat comments only).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with user credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/comments/episodes/:episodeId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body {"text": "..."} -> Receive 201 with Comment
GET /api/v1/comments/episodes/:episodeId -> Receive 200 with Comment[]
DELETE /api/v1/comments/:commentId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> as comment owner -> Receive 200 void
POST /api/v1/comments/episodes/:episodeId with empty text -> Receive 400 Validation error
DELETE /api/v1/comments/:commentId without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/v1/comments/episodes/:episodeId for non-existent episode -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Views API
features.description: Record a user's view of an episode while preventing duplicate views from the same user for the same episode.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with user credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
POST /api/v1/views/episodes/:episodeId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 201 with View
POST /api/v1/views/episodes/:episodeId with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (second attempt for same user/episode) -> Receive 200 with no new view created (idempotent)
POST /api/v1/views/episodes/:episodeId without Authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/v1/views/episodes/:episodeId for non-existent episode with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Admin API
features.description: Admin-only management of users and content plus platform statistics and moderation endpoints.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with TokenResponse
GET /api/v1/admin/users with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 with User[]
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:userId/deactivate with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 with User
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:userId/activate with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 with User
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:userId/promote with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 with User
DELETE /api/v1/admin/podcasts/:podcastId with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 void
DELETE /api/v1/admin/episodes/:episodeId with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 void
DELETE /api/v1/admin/comments/:commentId with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 void
GET /api/v1/admin/stats with Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token> -> Receive 200 with Stats
GET /api/v1/admin/users with Authorization: Bearer <non_admin_access_token> -> Receive 403 Forbidden
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:userId/deactivate with invalid user id -> Receive 404 Not found
